frozen_correction.pre_selection_failure: Atomically replace the writable selected-live drop-in with a read-only no-selection observer drop-in, reload systemd, and preserve the normal five-minute source cadence.
frozen_correction.selection_success: Install the exact tracked writable drop-in before the first selected recurrence, then require flat holdings, a null leg, and zero submitted orders before restoring cadence.
frozen_correction.post_selection_failure: Keep cadence disabled for exact reconciliation, unchanged from the predecessor transaction.
frozen_correction.selection_file: Preserve the predecessor or newly frozen successor intact; never move, rewrite, or delete it as a rollback mechanism.
